A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Bayesian ToM planner and contain readable main text, figures, tables, equations, and Appendices A–F. Corresponding material can be reliably matched throughout.

before.justification: V1 reports original evaluations of the proposed planner on MMToM-QA and MuMA-ToM, alongside scaling, transfer, and ablation experiments in the main text and appendices.

after.justification: V2 retains these original experimental results, including the proposed method's benchmark scores and supplementary experiments.

M1.justification: The Bayesian planner, instruction and preference training, and weak-to-strong policy reweighting in Equation 7 are unchanged. Revised score terminology does not establish an algorithm change.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same household belief/goal tasks, five thematic transfer scenarios, and MuMA-ToM social-interaction tasks. Appendix coverage is unchanged.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged, including SimToM, SymbolicToM, and BIPALM in Table 1, LIMP in Table 12, and the fine-tuning, PEFT, and naive-logit-addition controls.

E3.justification: Sections 4.6–4.7 revise the reported diagnostic quantity from likelihood changes/allocation to logit-score changes/allocation. Figure 3 explicitly identifies raw, unnormalized score shifts. This corrects the metric description; sampling, temperature, and other settings remain unchanged, with no evidence of rerunning experiments.

E4.justification: The scaling and transfer analyses, controller diagnostics, concept-level case study, and fine-tuning/control ablations are retained. Their questions and supporting evidence are unchanged; the revisions concern metric labeling and interpretation.

E5.justification: Figure 3 retains ten-case averaging, and Section 4.7 retains ten inference trials. No repeated-run information, uncertainty intervals, seed reporting, or statistical tests are added or revised.

E6.justification: Corresponding tables and plotted series retain their numerical values, rankings, and trends. For example, Table 1 still reports 81.3% multimodal accuracy for the proposed method versus 76.7% for BIPALM with Llama2-7B. The score-label correction adds no result entries.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, objectives, Bayesian equations, Theorem 1, and Appendix C proof are unchanged. The logit-score clarification introduces no mathematical definition or derivation.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same scalability and weak-to-strong transfer contributions and the same claimed 4.6% accuracy improvement.

C2.justification: Sections 4.6–4.7 and Figures 3–4 now interpret the diagnostics as logit-score shifts and allocation rather than likelihood changes. Figure 3 expressly excludes normalized likelihoods, qualifying what the plotted magnitudes mean while retaining the broader mechanism conclusions.

D1.justification: The preprocessing, LoRA configurations, training resources, runtime information, and repository access statement are unchanged, including the details in Appendices B, D, and F.

R1.justification: The cited works, related-work discussion, and research positioning in Section 5 and Appendix A are unchanged.

P1.justification: Localized terminology edits replace likelihood with logit-score language in Sections 4.6–4.7, the Section 4.7 heading, and figure captions. The document structure and appendix prose remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 2's legends and Figure 3's vertical-axis label are revised, Figure 3's display is resized, and captions for Figures 2–4 are updated. The figure/table inventory and underlying plotted series remain intact.

improvement.justification: V2 corrects misleading likelihood labels in Figures 2–4 and their discussion, explicitly distinguishing Figure 3's raw logit-score shifts from normalized likelihoods. This improves interpretation of the existing diagnostics. The gain is limited to reporting accuracy and clarity; the algorithm, proofs, experimental evidence, and appendices are unchanged.
